description: Add a native UI/UX design capability to the e2e-engineering flow: a generic ui-design anti-slop standard, a DESIGN.md schema (Stitch format), a conditional pre-impl `design` sub-skill, a `product-designer` advisor agent, plus wiring across SKILL entry points, sub-skills, durable docs, and routers. Spec/code-only (Fork Y; no image-gen in the flow). Brownfield self-modifying docs/tooling Task. VERIFICATION GATE = `npm run build && npm run validate` -> `validate: ok` (NO Vitest/Playwright; no unit/API/UI tests apply). `sliceType` values are nominal (docs task, not a code DAG). Implements plan synthetic-booping-cocke.md. OUT OF SCOPE: v1.9.0 version bump + release commit; image-gen design path; un-deprecating the `ui-designer` token.

stories.title: Generic ui-design anti-slop standard
stories.description: New standards/ui-design.md, caveman-ultra, mirroring standards/api-testing.md. Generic UI/UX taste + anti-slop rules, Product-register by default, brand rules register-gated. Injected into `ui` slices; read by product-designer + frontend-reviewer.
acceptanceCriteria: File skills/e2e-engineering/standards/ui-design.md exists, caveman-ultra, mirrors api-testing.md shape.

Register-first section: Product (default: dense, predictable, readable states, quiet motion, a11y/audit-first) vs Brand (gated). Every rule notes its register; reader checks DESIGN.md Overview register before applying.

Covers 7 areas: Typography (ban overused defaults as whole identity; pair display+body; >=1.25x hierarchy; line-height 1.5-1.7; body >=14px), Color (OKLCH + descriptive names; tint black/grays; ban AI palette + gradient text), Layout (no nested cards; radius 12-16px; max-width 65-75ch; >=16px padding), Components (reuse owned; loading/empty/error/:active/disabled states; WCAG AA; no placeholder-as-label), Motion (transform/opacity only; ban bounce/elastic; prefers-reduced-motion mandatory; brand-gated scroll choreography), Accessibility (AA contrast, focus order, roles, keyboard, no skipped heading levels), Anti-slop tells (concrete catalog subset: side-tab border accent, icon-tile-above-heading, identical 3-card grids, numbered eyebrows, hero version labels, div fake screenshots, filler copy).
Each rule tagged enforcement layer: `slice-reviewer` (source-readable) vs `human-QA/LLM` (needs rendered layout — line length/overflow/contrast/padding ride to human-QA per Fork Y).
Em-dash ban scoped to GENERATED UI COPY ONLY, with explicit note it does NOT apply to caveman skill docs.
Project-override note: DESIGN.md overrides this baseline where they conflict (same rule as api-testing.md vs ARCHITECTURE.md section 4).
stories.notes: Net-new, no contention. Verification: link/JSON pass deferred to build-validate story.

stories.title: DESIGN.md schema (Stitch cross-tool format)
stories.description: New schemas/design.md documenting the durable DESIGN.md format. Mirrors schemas/architecture.md governance.
acceptanceCriteria: File skills/e2e-engineering/schemas/design.md exists.

Documents DESIGN.md Stitch format, 6 fixed sections in fixed order/names: 1 Overview (Creative North Star metaphor + register Brand/Product + brand voice in 3 real words), 2 Colors (OKLCH, descriptive names), 3 Typography, 4 Elevation, 5 Components, 6 Do's & Don'ts; then trailing §Index (line numbers, written last, for offset/limit).
Notes: repo-root; human-phase-written ONLY (pre-impl seed + post-impl amend); READ-only in flight; greenfield may carry provisional `<!-- SEED -->` marker until components exist.
Carries explicit 'rewrite §Index line numbers after every edit' instruction (matches ARCHITECTURE.md schema discipline).
